## Board of Directors - Minutes Q1 2025

Strictly confidential

## 1. Attendance and quorum

Meeting held on 23 April 2025 at Tampere Works, Finland. Present: Maria Peltoniemi, Margareta Lindqvist (Chair), Henrik Aalto, Dr. Ines Carvalho, Pieter van Dam, Valdemar Peltonen. Also in attendance: Ilari Pesonen (COO) and Anne Laakkonen (General Counsel, secretary to the board). Quorum was confirmed.

The minutes of the previous meeting were approved without amendment.

## 2. Financial performance

The CFO reported Q1 FY2025 revenue of EUR 100.2 million against a budget of EUR 97.8 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 14.0% and cash of EUR 38.8 million.

Order intake for the quarter was EUR 103.8 million, giving a book-to-bill ratio of 1.04.

| KPI | Q1 FY2025 | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | EUR 100.2m | EUR 97.8m |
| EBITDA margin | 14.0% | 14.5% |
| LTIFR | 0.73 | 0.70 |
| On-time delivery | 93.6% | 93.0% |

## 3. Resolutions

The Board authorised management to begin exclusive due diligence on Kestrel Fluid Controls (Project Nordlys).

The Board approved the FY2026 operating budget of EUR 386.3m.

The next meeting is scheduled for 23 July 2025.
